task.name: Fill_kitchen_drinking_water_dispensers
task.when: Once per Afternoon and Pre-event shift

step.action: Place the outlet of 🔧 Potable_Water_Hose inside the first 🍳 Drinking_Water_Dispensers dispenser without touching the outlet to the dispenser.
Open 🔧 Fresh_Water_Tank and fill the dispenser to its full line.
Place the hose outlet inside the second dispenser without touching the outlet to the dispenser.
Open 🔧 Fresh_Water_Tank and fill the second dispenser to its full line.
Hold the hose outlet over the second dispenser until it stops dripping.
Coil 🔧 Potable_Water_Hose without letting its ends touch the playa.

passWhen.criterion: Both drinking-water dispensers are filled to their full lines.
Both lids are closed and neither dispenser leaks.

reasoning.entry: Use a potable-water hose rather than the shower or a garden hose so drinking water is not contaminated.
